connector.name: MCP Upload
connector.registryDescription: Public file storage for AI agents. Upload files and get a permalink back.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-upload. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace sh.objekt. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBJEKT_API_KEY
env.description: API key from objekt.sh/mcp (free tier available)
